Description: Root pass porosity exceeding API 1104 acceptance on 6 joints (W-4A-0062 to 0067)
Root_Cause: Contaminated shielding gas batch and excessive wind during welding
Corrective_Action: Purge gas lines; replace shielding gas cylinders; erect wind shelters around joint tents; execute grind-out repair per approved repair WPS-API1104-03

Description: Field joint coating holiday test failures at 11 joints (CH 3+180 to 3+250)
Root_Cause: Insufficient pipe surface profile (Sa 2.0 vs Sa 2.5) and inadequate pre-heat temperature (<200C) prior to shrink sleeve application
Corrective_Action: Strip defective heat shrink sleeves; re-blast surface to Sa 2.5 profile (75-100 microns); pre-heat with induction coil to 210C; reapply Covalence sleeves; re-test at 15kV holiday voltage

Description: Foundation concrete cube strength below 28-day specified value (26.4 MPa vs 35 MPa required on foundation F-03)
Action: Core testing ordered; structural review in progress
Root_Cause: High water-cement ratio batch delivery from ready-mix batching plant
Corrective_Action: Take 6 core samples for compressive strength testing per ASTM C42; perform structural load reassessment; batch plant QA audit initiated; reject non-compliant batch supplier

Description: Radiography backlog exceeding 10 working days against procedure limit (11.5 days backlog)
Action: Second RT crew requested from subcontractor
Root_Cause: Shortage of certified Level II radiographers and darkroom processing unit equipment breakdown
Corrective_Action: Mobilise second RT night crew with mobile darkroom truck; prioritise mainline welds on critical path; expedite backlog clearance

Description: Drilling fluid loss and partial hole collapse during 36-inch reaming pass
Root_Cause: Uncharted unconsolidated gravel lens and fractured shale stratum at depth 18m
Corrective_Action: Suspend reaming; pump LCM (lost circulation material) bentonite-polymer pill; drill geotechnical boreholes at offset; revise mud rheology and drill path profile

Description: Trench depth below specified minimum cover in rocky section (1.1m vs 1.5m required)
Root_Cause: Rock breaker encountered hard basalt layer; machine operator failed to verify depth against survey benchmark
Corrective_Action: Deploy hydraulic breaker to deepen rock trench to 1.7m; verify with optical survey; place 150mm sand bedding prior to pipe lowering

Description: 3LPE field joint peel adhesion test failure (<0.3 MPa at 23C vs 0.5 MPa required per ISO 21809-3)
Action: Laboratory testing of liquid epoxy primer adhesion underway
Root_Cause: Suspected expired liquid epoxy primer component B activator or moisture condensation on steel surface
Corrective_Action: Quarantine primer lot B-8821; send sample to metallurgical lab; heat induction cycle time extended to eliminate surface moisture before primer application

Description: Trench backfill compaction below specification (Modified Proctor density measured 88% vs 95% minimum at road crossing)
Action: Excavation and re-compaction in 200mm layers instructed
Root_Cause: Backfill placed in 600mm loose lifts without adequate mechanical vibratory compaction
Corrective_Action: Excavate backfill to top of padding; place selected fill in 200mm lifts; compact using trench roller to achieve 95% Modified Proctor density; re-test with nuclear density gauge

Description: Internal high-low alignment mismatch measured 3.8mm exceeding API 1104 3.0mm max tolerance on joint W-4A-0104
Action: Joint cut out and re-beveled; fit-up re-inspected
Root_Cause: Pipe end out-of-roundness caused by handling dent at bevel
Corrective_Action: Cut out defective pipe pup; use internal pneumatic line-up clamp with hydraulic shoe reform; verify high-low mismatch <=1.6mm around circumference

Description: RTJ Octagonal Ring Gasket (Soft Iron) scored and damaged during pre-assembly on 24-inch Class 600 MOV-101 inlet flange
Action: Flange face inspected; gasket replaced with new certified spare; torque verified
Root_Cause: Improper handling and misalignment during manual crane lift into valve skid
Corrective_Action: Perform dye penetrant test on flange RTJ groove (accepted); replace damaged gasket with new serialized stock; tighten flange bolts in cross-pattern torque sequence per ASME PCC-1

Description: Cathodic protection test post TP-04 instant-off potential reading -0.76V CSE failing NACE SP0169 -0.85V polarization criterion
Action: CP specialist investigating stray current interference and anode cable connection
Root_Cause: High soil resistivity zone and loose mechanical crimp lug on magnesium sacrificial anode lead
Corrective_Action: Inspect anode lead junction box; re-crimp and solder cable terminal; install supplementary deep anode groundbed if soil resistivity survey confirms high resistance

Description: Mill Test Certificate for 24-inch line pipe Heat No. H44821 missing transverse Charpy V-notch impact energy at -20C
Action: Pipes from Heat H44821 quarantined; supplier requested for revised 3.1 MTC from mill
Root_Cause: Mill test data transcription error on vendor transmittal VT-2025-0619
Corrective_Action: Issue formal hold on 48 pipe joints from Heat H44821; expedite revised EN 10204 3.1 certificate with Charpy test values from Tenaris mill

Description: Interpass preheat temperature measured 85C below 100C minimum specified in WPS-API1104-01 on joint W-4B-0042 during rain squall
Action: Welding stopped; joint cut out; crew briefed on preheat verification using tempil sticks
Root_Cause: Sudden ambient temperature drop and localized wind cooling joint during rain squall
Corrective_Action: Cut out joint W-4B-0042; re-bevel pipe ends; provide infrared preheat thermometer to welding foreman; ensure preheat >=100C is maintained 75mm on both sides of joint

Description: Cold field bend FB-4A-088 cross-sectional ovality measured 2.9% exceeding specification limit of 2.5%
Action: Bend rejected and scrapped; mandrel bending machine calibrated
Root_Cause: Hydraulic internal bending mandrel pressure dropped below 140 bar during bending pull
Corrective_Action: Scrap non-conforming bend FB-4A-088; service hydraulic power pack and pressure relief valve on CRC-Evans bending machine; re-bend replacement pipe with verified mandrel pressure

Description: AUT calibration block reference flat bottom hole notch out of ASME Sec V Art 4 tolerance due to surface oxidation
Action: Calibration block polished and recertified against master block
Root_Cause: Storage of calibration block in damp site container without protective oil coating
Corrective_Action: Clean and micro-polish calibration block; perform ultrasonic recalibration in lab; store all NDT calibration blocks in climate-controlled Pelican cases with desiccant
